evals.name: mixed-backlog
evals.prompt: Audit DEMO-1 through DEMO-12 using tickets.json, snapshot.md, rules.md and supplied repository at base main. Write assessment to output/.
evals.repository_setup: See procedure.md: clean main has resolve(user), working has resolve(user, legacy); both lack return annotations.
expectations: Exactly ten eligible scored rows DEMO-1 through DEMO-10; DEMO-11/12 excluded and DEMO-90 context-only. Active QA, QA Rejected and On Hold remain included.
DEMO-1 Correctness incorrect for delete/retain conflict and Consistency incorrect for Pending vs Reserved, citing current source; incorrect findings precede hidden scope and cheap gaps.
DEMO-2 hidden independent CSV/email/audit scope and unresolved design destination are surfaced; vague AC is weak and missing design destination is limited to available evidence.
DEMO-3 genuinely empty bug has missing reproduction evidence; DEMO-10 sufficient request/expected/actual evidence is not penalized for lacking screenshot or browser details.
DEMO-4 uses light pass without mandatory Why/design link; DEMO-5 research output and DEMO-9 coherent epic/child are not judged as oversized implementation tasks.
DEMO-6 full empty description and completed parent DEMO-90 are read; unfinished-child conflict is flagged without automatically closing it.
DEMO-7 checked on main commit (not working) has stale argument-removal diagnosis scored incorrect while valid return-annotation work is preserved. User checkout remains working and unchanged.
DEMO-8 priority, parent and blocker metadata mismatches are named against prose and snapshot convention.

Nine rubric columns, every non-good/applicability note, sources and source-absence limitations, reconciled counts, no numeric aggregate, no Jira writes/implementation claims; readiness agrees with defects.

evals.name: incomplete-rerun
evals.prompt: Refresh the assessment using rerun-page.json, rerun-snapshot.md, rules.md and previous.md; write to output/.
expectations: Nonfinal page/missing next page is reported; five retrieved keys, four eligible, one Done excluded, with no whole-backlog completeness claim.
DEMO-7 omitted description/metadata and unavailable repository are unassessed, not missing, n/a, good or resolved; old stale diagnosis remains unverified.
DEMO-1 old contradiction and vocabulary findings resolved using current text/source; DEMO-3 left scope due to Done, not proven defect resolution.
DEMO-4 On Hold to QA transition and newly observed DEMO-13 recorded; missing-page DEMO-20 not declared left scope or fixed.
DEMO-9 inaccessible parent/context noted where relevant; available positive findings retained without inferred inaccessible content.
Per-ticket nine-column table with explicit unassessed notation, evidence-backed rerun section and consistent qualified readiness; no live calls or mutations.
